services.desc: From your first demo flight to a career as a CFI - we have the aircraft, the instructors, and the programs to get you airborne. Vineyard tours, aerial photography, VIP transport, and commercial operations - every flight is an extraordinary experience. From the nimble R-22 to the turbine-powered R-66 and iconic MD-500C - our diverse fleet supports every stage of training. Looking for an unforgettable experience?
